title: AI Dart Turret
stub: Floor-standing pan-tilt dart turret (~4 ft on a tripod) with vision-guided targeting.
finished: Motion testing, Hold and sweeps complete
todo: AI target selection and safe fire logic
content:
A floor-standing automated turret on a tripod — about four feet tall — with two-axis aiming, an X-Shot Ragefire dart launcher, FPGA-assisted motion tracking, and AI target selection.

Mechanical work covers the pan-tilt head, launcher linkage, and tripod mounting. Electronics handle motor drivers, firing control, camera input, and a dedicated power path. Software ties together frame capture, inference, and fire logic with sane limits.

Right now the power supply mount is close — PSU on the bracket, protection in, twist lock being dialed in — then back to powered driver tests.
